label: Wind turbines built in Nova Scotia since 2018 (EA filings)
notice: Wind turbines built in Nova Scotia since 2018, which NRCan's database does not list yet. Positions are from tables in each farm's environmental assessment filing, not as-built surveys: some turbines were built up to about 130 m from the tabulated spot, and each point says how far the nearest cleared pad is in Sentinel-2 imagery.
